core.headline: Four-bedroom semi-detached house, Sevenoaks
core.listing:
A well-proportioned 1930s semi-detached house in Sevenoaks, extended and reconfigured to provide four bedrooms, three bathrooms and adaptable family living space. The property retains its original stained-glass front door and hall window.

The ground floor comprises a sitting room with log burner, a separate dining room, and a kitchen/family room created by the 2021 extension. The kitchen/family room measures 7.80m x 5.10m max (25'7" x 16'9" max) and features an island, bi-fold doors to the garden, and underfloor heating. The former garage has been converted to provide a utility room and ground-floor shower room.

The first floor offers three bedrooms and a family bathroom. The principal bedroom measures 4.20m x 3.60m (13'9" x 11'10"). A loft conversion completed in 2019 with a building regulations completion certificate provides the fourth bedroom, which measures 5.20m x 3.30m max (17'1" x 10'10" max), and an en-suite.

The south-west-facing rear garden extends approximately 30m (100ft) and includes a patio and a garden office with power. A driveway provides parking for two cars.

Oak Lane is approximately 0.8 miles from Sevenoaks station, with services to London Bridge taking approximately 25 minutes. Sevenoaks School and Knole Park are nearby.

Guide Price £975,000. Freehold. Council Tax Band F (Sevenoaks District Council). EPC rating D. Construction: Standard – Brick and render under a clay-tiled roof. Electricity: Mains. Water: Mains (metered). Sewerage: Mains. Heating: Gas central heating; underfloor heating in kitchen/family room. Broadband: FTTP, Up to 900Mbps. Mobile signal: Good indoor and outdoor coverage. Parking: Driveway for two cars. The 2021 rear extension was built with planning permission. Building safety, restrictions, rights and easements, flooding, coastal erosion, accessibility and coalfield/mining: None known.
